title: Hash Divided String
summary: Given a string s of length n, where n is divisible by k, divide s into n/k substrings of length k.
statement: Given a string s of length n, where n is divisible by k, divide s into n/k substrings of length k. For each substring, compute the sum of the hash values of its characters, find the remainder when divided by 26, and append the corresponding lowercase English letter to the result string. Return the result string.
constraints: s contains lowercase English letters, 1≤k≤100, and len(s) is divisible by k.
For each consecutive size-k chunk, sum alphabet indices a=0 through z=25.
Reduce each sum modulo 26, convert it back to a letter, and concatenate the letters.
hints: Each output character depends on one fixed-size chunk only.
Scan chunks in order and accumulate zero-based alphabet values.
Take the sum modulo 26 and convert the resulting index back to a lowercase letter.
The chunks partition s, so processing each once produces exactly one output character in the required order.
editorial: The chunks partition s, so processing each once produces exactly one output character in the required order.

tests.explanation: ab hashes to 1→b and cd hashes to 5→f, producing bf.
The only chunk sums to 60; 60 modulo 26 is 8, which maps to i.
